activities.name: Driver to LAX
activities.notes: Need to book

activities.name: Check In to Flight and Eat Lunch
Flight: Air France LAX → CDG
activities.notes: Confirmation: YZIYVJ. Departs 3:25 PM on Air France.

activities.name: Arrive at Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport
activities.location: Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport, 95700 Roissy-en-France, France
activities.notes: Arrival at CDG. Proceed to Terminal 2 TGV station.

activities.name: Train: TGV INOUI 12526 CDG → Marne-la-Vallée Chessy
activities.notes: Departs 12:11 PM. Non-stop. Platform 6.

activities.name: Train: TGV INOUI 5440 Marne-la-Vallée → Champagne-Ardenne TGV
activities.notes: Departs 12:32 PM. Non-stop service toward Strasbourg.

activities.name: Transfer: Champagne-Ardenne TGV
activities.notes: Short platform transfer (~1 minute walk).

activities.name: Train: TER 839739 Champagne-Ardenne → Reims
activities.notes: Departs 1:10 PM. 3 stops. Toward Sedan.

activities.name: Arrive in Reims
activities.notes: Arrival at Reims station at approximately 1:22 PM.

activities.name: Visit to Reims Cathedral
activities.location: Place du Cardinal Luçon, 51100 Reims, France
activities.notes: Site of coronation of French kings. UNESCO World Heritage Site. Gothic masterpiece completed in the 13th century.

activities.name: Dinner at Hotel
activities.location: 15 Quai de la Tournelle, 75005 Paris, France
activities.notes: One Michelin star. Founded in 1582. Iconic riverside setting with views of Notre-Dame. Wine cellar with 300,000+ bottles. Phone: +33 1 43 54 23 31.

lodging.name: Hotel Le Bristol
lodging.address: 112 Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré, 75008 Paris, France

activities.name: Dinner at Le Pré Catelan
activities.location: Route de Suresnes — Bois de Boulogne, 75016 Paris, France
activities.notes: Three Michelin stars. Chef Frédéric Anton leads a refined, precision-driven menu focusing on top-drawer produce. Closed Mon & Sun; dinner seating 19:00–20:45.

activities.name: TGV to Champagne
activities.notes: High-speed train to Reims, Champagne region.

activities.name: Wine Tasting at Louis Roederer
activities.notes: Private tasting. One of the oldest independent Champagne houses, founded in 1776.

activities.name: Private Driver to Bollinger
activities.notes: 35-minute drive from Reims to Aÿ.

activities.name: Wine Tasting at Bollinger
activities.notes: Renowned for its full-bodied Pinot Noir–dominant cuvées and association with James Bond films.

activities.name: Private Driver back to Château de Sacy
activities.location: Château de Sacy, Rue des Croisettes
activities.notes: Return to hotel for rest.

activities.name: TGV to Paris
activities.notes: Return by high-speed train.

activities.name: Check-in: Hotel Cheval Blanc
activities.notes: Luxury hotel facing the Seine.

activities.name: Dinner at Le Tout-Paris
activities.location: Cheval Blanc Paris, 8 Quai du Louvre, 75001 Paris, France
activities.notes: One Michelin star. Elegant brasserie under Arnaud Donckele.

activities.name: Flight: CDG → LAX
activities.notes: Air France departs at 3:55 PM. Arrives in LAX at 6:15 PM local time.
